prova:
intro r h2
  have h2' : r ≥ 2 := h2
  have hr_pos : 0 < r := by omega
  have h_full_1 : Nat.Full r 1 := by
    intro p hp
    have : p ^ r ∣ 1 := by
      simp [Nat.dvd_one]
    exact this
  refine ⟨fun n => ⟨List.rep (r + 1) 1, by simp [List.length_rep], fun x hx => h_full_1, by simp [List.sum_rep, Nat.mul_one]⟩, by rintro n hn⟩
